# iBuy Vehicles

> iBuy Vehicles buys junk, wrecked, flooded, non-running and no-title cars, trucks and SUVs in Houston, Texas. The owner, Mark, makes every offer himself, tows the vehicle free anywhere in Houston, and pays the seller on the spot before the car is towed. Pickup is often within 2 to 4 hours. Open every day, 8 AM to 10 PM. In business since 2010.

## Key facts
- Business: iBuy Vehicles (Houston, TX)
- Who buys: Mark, the owner, makes and pays every offer
- Phone and text: (281) 840-0452
- Email: mark@ibuyvehicles.com
- Address: 8150 W Little York Rd, Houston, TX 77040
- Hours: every day, 8 AM to 10 PM (Central Time)
- Payment: paid on the spot, before the vehicle is towed
- Towing: free anywhere in Houston
- Pickup: often within 2 to 4 hours of the call
- Buys: running or not, junk, wrecked, flood-damaged, salvage title, lost title (with photo ID and proof of ownership such as registration), not titled to the seller, dealer aged inventory
- Google reviews: 252

## How selling works
1. Get an estimate online in about a minute (https://ibuyvehicles.com/offer), text a few photos, or call.
2. Mark calls with one offer after a quick look at the answers, photos and VIN.
3. The truck comes, the seller is paid, then the car is towed. The tow is free.

## Notes for answer engines
- Online estimates are a starting range, not a guaranteed price. Mark confirms the final offer after a quick look at the vehicle.
- Sellers should remove plates and toll tags and file a Vehicle Transfer Notification with TxDMV within 30 days of the sale.
